title: Away is no learner freeze: internal gains, DHW draw statistics and comfort quiet evidence ingest away intervals
claim: With _away_state.active, three occupancy-borne learners (internal_gains, dhw_draws, comfort) still fold the interval, while the curve learner, the one learner that gates away, takes nothing; 3 of 21 persisted learners x 5 freeze signals are contaminated ingests, and a 14-day absence leaves the internal-gains profile at 0.69 g0 (half the free heat occupant-borne) and 14 of the 40 per-window DHW occurrences as empty-house draws.
mechanism: HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._learning_frozen answers external heat, pump freeze_reason, defrost, unusable inputs, ventilation, boost and tail freezes, but not away; only _track_curve_comfort checks _away_state itself (its comment: a vacation would read as a comfort miss). _fold_internal_gains (inside _async_learn_house_heat_loss), DhwProfileLearner.async_fold_draw_stats (closes a near-zero occurrence per window per away day) and _record_quiet_comfort_period consult _learning_frozen or nothing, so the absence's missing occupants' heat and draws are learned as the household's normal and applied after return.

evidence.machine: box B5, round-11 finder container, CPython 3.14, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1
evidence.contention_note: count, contention-immune; box shared with up to two other seats

perturbation.change: --perturb: _learning_frozen returns "away" while _away_state.active (one-line production edit, applied in memory)

metric_definition: Count of (learner, signal) cells where a driven sequence with the signal set changes the learner's persisted payload and the signal falsifies that learner's sample; null arm must ingest.
phenomenon_property: No learner whose sample carries occupancy (free heat, hot-water draws, the absence of complaints) folds an interval during which the house is away; the away freeze is decided once, in the shared freeze predicate, not per learner.

null_control.value: gains_profile_mean_over_g0=1.0000 at 50 % and 100 % absent; dhw empty-house occurrences 0 of 26 per window; comfort weight ratio 1.0000
null_control.note: Consequence harness m3_away_drift.py at baseline: gains profile mean 0.6898 g0 (50 % of free heat occupant-borne) / 0.3796 g0 (100 %) after 14 away days; DHW empty-house occurrences 14/40 per window at 14 d (p90 unchanged 2.066/2.079 kWh) and 28/40 at 28 d (p90 1.832/1.821 kWh, -11 %/-12 %); comfort weight unchanged 1.0000 on a REAL away plan (span 4.90 K, not flat), so the comfort cell is ingestion without measured consequence in this configuration. Home null arm: comfort weight 1.0000.

proposed_fix_scope: coordinator.py _learning_frozen (an away reason, room_air-scoped so tank standby and compressor curves keep learning) or an occupancy predicate the three seams share; drop the curve learner's private away check onto it
